$description: Structured representation of Evaluation Scenarios 001-003. Derived from context/product.md Section 8. Non-authoritative — see context/manifest.md §7. These are behavioral tests used to reveal weaknesses in the product model and Experience Constitution, not merely feature examples.

scenarios.title: Predicted inventory collision
scenarios.potential_inference: the current rental may return late enough to threaten the downstream reservation
scenarios.missing_information_discovered: Return time alone is insufficient; Contera may need an Equipment Turnaround Requirement or equivalent operational data (inspection, cleaning, refueling, or other work). Illustrative example only: expected return 10:47 AM + 30 min turnaround = 11:17 AM estimated readiness; the 30-minute value is illustrative, not established policy/data.

working_decision.intervention_priority: Action needed, not necessarily urgent at 8:00 AM because the conflict is predicted rather than actual
working_decision.recommended_action: Contact the current renter to confirm expected return time
working_decision.initial_governance: human review before sending communication, pending unresolved communication policy

evidence_a_human_should_inspect: current renter identity and preferred contact information
anticipated return time and the basis for that prediction
lessons: Potential impact and intervention urgency must be separate.
Predictions must not be presented as known facts.
Resolve material uncertainty before unnecessarily involving downstream affected parties.
The ontology was missing turnaround requirements.
Opaque confidence percentages may be less useful than exposing the evidence and assumptions driving the prediction.

scenarios.title: Suspected new equipment damage

situation.checkout_photos: eight photographs; no obvious damage detected in the affected area
situation.return_photos: visible dent/scrape on right rear panel
situation.rental_agreement: customer is responsible for damage occurring during the rental
situation.complication: checkout photograph of the relevant panel taken in poor lighting and partly obscured by mud

permitted: Observe: identify visible damage in return evidence
Compare: identify that the damage is not clearly visible in checkout evidence
Infer: state that damage may have occurred during the rental
Recommend: request a secondary human inspection
Prepare: assemble evidence, relevant rental information, repair estimate, and a draft damage report
prohibited: conclude that the customer caused the damage
autonomously assess or collect the proposed charge
working_behavior.governance: Manager review required before consequential customer action

evidence_presentation_requirement: highlighted or otherwise inspectable visual difference where useful
known prior damage history if available
scenarios.human_controls_note: Exact UI controls are not yet designed.
lessons: Rule 001 evolved from 'resolve uncertainty at its source' to 'resolve material uncertainty before consequential action.'
Capability and governance cannot be represented as one linear ladder.
Prepare and Escalate may occur together.
Observation, inference, recommendation, human determination, and business action must remain distinct.

scenarios.title: Possible safety-critical equipment issue

situation.prior_inspection_note: "Hydraulic line looks a little worn. Probably fine for another rental but someone should look at it." — dictated by Yard Associate during yesterday's return inspection; inspection nevertheless marked Passed.

if_allowed_and_hydraulic_line_fails: potential safety impact may be High

working_risk_assessment.consequence: High on both paths, with safety potentially more severe
working_risk_assessment.irreversibility: allowing a potentially unsafe rental could have High irreversibility if failure causes injury; blocking/delaying is more reversible but still has residual customer/business cost
working_risk_assessment.evidentiary_uncertainty: Moderate — two signals of risk, but no qualified mechanic has determined the hose unsafe

permitted: Observe: identify the combination of wear note and exceeded maintenance interval
Explain: expose the supporting inspection note, operating hours, and manufacturer recommendation
As a WORKING HYPOTHESIS, prevent ordinary checkout progression until appropriate human review occurs

Prepare safe operational alternatives (equivalent equipment at nearby branches, estimated transfer time, substitute equipment classes, customer schedule flexibility, upgrade options, delivery alternatives)
prohibited: Claiming 'Equipment unsafe' unless a qualified determination supports that statement
working_behavior.required_language_instead: "Safety review required" or equivalent behavioral meaning
working_behavior.unresolved: The exact human role authorized to clear or fail the equipment.

lessons: Safety can require asymmetric evidentiary thresholds.
High-consequence uncertainty may justify temporary intervention before proof of failure exists.
Time sensitivity is distinct from consequence and evidentiary uncertainty.
When AI introduces friction, it should help resolve the operational consequences.

revalidation_note: These scenario records are frozen evaluation fixtures as documented in product.md Section 8. They are not live product data and must not be treated as current inventory, customer, or equipment state.
